This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Sagrona Teema" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|pale]] skin, orange [[hair]], upturned [[nose]]s, and sunken [[eye]]s.<ref name="Sagrona Teema" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[4 BBY]], a member of this species was in attendance at the wedding ceremony of [[Leida Mothma]] and [[Stekan Sculdun]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on the [[planet]] [[Chandrila]].<ref name="Sagrona Teema" /> Two years later, at least one member of this species frequented the [[Imperial Senate Building]],<ref name="Messenger">{{Andor|Messenger}}</ref> witnessing [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[Escape from the Senate|escape from the Senate]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:UnidentifiedOrangeHairedHumanoidSpecies-IvanManzella.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art by Ivan Manzella.]]
The species made their debut in the [[Sagrona Teema|second episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Sagrona Teema" /> directed by [[Ariel Kleiman]] and aired on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> This species was designed by concept artist and sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]].<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creature & Character Designs|author=[[Ivan Manzella|Manzella, Ivan]]|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250715083228}}</ref>
